title: A gate is classed push by a push action, not by the words origin or remote
goal: bl_authority.gate_class does not class a gate push when its question and options hold only origin, remote, release, a forge name or merge request and no word for a write to a shared branch; a forge name inside a host name such as docs.gitlab.com is no push word either, on an item of the query log store too; a gate whose host_check or do command pushes keeps the class

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_authority as b
kb = {"id": "ST-x", "touches": ["kb/public/**"]}
rules = {"id": "ST-x", "touches": ["kb/public/**", "skills/sprint/SKILL.md", "kb/_self/backlog.md"]}
tool = {"id": "ST-x", "touches": ["_tools/fetch.py", "_tools/census.py"]}
cases = [
 (kb, "How is the stale eval row, which fails the eval on origin/main, resolved?"),
 (kb, "How does a census brief give a session a git ls-remote line?"),
 (tool, "How does the azurerm docs route name the newest release for a latest url, and what does it read when the registry does not answer?"),
 (rules, "How are the 118 gap entries re-read, as the reviews of 2026-10-21 did for the gitlab closings?"),
 (tool, "How does backlog.json name a host item branch, merge request title and trailer?"),
]
bad = [q for it, q in cases if b.gate_class(it, {"id": "g1", "question": q, "options": ["a", "b"], "recommendation": "a"}) == "push"]
real = b.gate_class(tool, {"id": "g1", "question": "Which branch name?", "options": ["a", "b"], "host_check": ["git", "push", "origin", "HEAD:main"]})
print(len(bad), "read-only questions classed push:", bad, "| command gate:", real)
sys.exit(1 if bad or real != "push" else 0)

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_authority as b
item = {"id": "ST-x", "touches": ["kb/_querylog/findings/**"]}
q = "How are the four route findings (docs.gitlab.com, learn.microsoft.com) closed?"
c = b.gate_class(item, {"id": "g2", "question": q, "options": ["hand-written records", "leave them open"], "recommendation": "hand-written records"})
print("host-name question classed", c)
sys.exit(1 if c == "push" else 0)

gates.question: Which wording of a gate keeps it operator-only as a write to a shared branch, now that a bare forge name, branch host name or request noun no longer does?
options: Write verbs alone: a gate is operator-only when its text holds a verb that writes to a shared branch (the verb words of today's list), wherever it stands, even in a question that only asks what a setting defaults to
Write verbs, except in a question that only asks what a setting, a key or a default is, with no modal asking anyone to run it (the default-key gate of BG-hjxvxufh is then a design gate)
The gate's do and host_check commands alone; no word of the question or options classes it
